title: Lambda asset hash drift in cdk diff: five Lambdas show S3Key changes with identical index.mjs
description: cdk diff shows S3Key changes on five Lambdas although index.mjs is byte identical. Likely sourcemap or hash nondeterminism in bundling. Investigate and make asset hashes reproducible so diffs are quiet.
right_now_summary: The team is investigating nondeterministic Lambda asset hashes despite identical index.mjs files.
